headline: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson set to return against Buffalo Bills
standfirst: Baltimore Ravens star Lamar Jackson will make his long-awaited return from an ankle injury on Sunday against the Buffalo Bills.
keyPoints: Lamar Jackson has not played since suffering a high ankle sprain in Week 4.
Coach Jesse Minter confirmed Jackson will start against the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
The Ravens dropped to last place in the AFC North after losing their last two games.
Buffalo currently concedes an average of 28.5 points per contest.

paragraphs: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson is scheduled to make his comeback this weekend after being sidelined since the fourth week of the season. The two-time Most Valuable Player sustained a high ankle sprain during the final play of the opening half in a victory over the Tennessee Titans. Team leadership confirmed his availability during a media briefing ahead of Sunday's upcoming fixture.

The franchise has experienced a sharp decline in the standings during the absence of their primary playmaker. After opening the campaign with four consecutive victories, the squad has dropped consecutive matches and fallen to the bottom of the division. Tyler Huntley filled in under center during the recent struggles, including a blowout loss where the offense failed to score after halftime.

The upcoming fixture features a matchup against the Buffalo Bills at a time when the defensive unit has struggled to contain opponents. Buffalo currently surrenders an average of 28.5 points per game, representing one of the highest totals across the league. Jackson's presence is expected to provide an immediate spark for an offensive unit that struggled significantly in recent outings.

sections.heading: Injury context and historical performance
paragraphs: The athletic signal-caller has spent more than three weeks recovering from the high ankle sprain sustained earlier in the autumn. Before the physical setback, the veteran maintained impressive statistical marks through the first month of competition. He successfully completed nearly seventy-one percent of his throws while collecting six touchdowns against a single interception.

In addition to his passing statistics, the offensive leader contributed significantly with his rushing ability prior to the injury. He accumulated 144 yards on the ground alongside a rushing score while averaging over seven yards per carry. That rushing average exceeded his career baseline by a notable margin, demonstrating his dynamic impact on the field.

The franchise hopes that reintegrating the star athlete will restore stability to an offense that plummeted during the second half of last week's defeat. The team surrendered thirty-five points after the intermission in that contest, matching an unwanted franchise milestone for defensive struggles during a single half of football. Restoring the starting lineup leader aims to reverse that downward trend immediately.

sections.heading: Team objectives and tactical approach
paragraphs: Coaching staff members have emphasized the necessity of steady execution as the squad attempts to climb out of last place in a highly contested division. The recent slide has placed heightened pressure on the roster to secure a victory against formidable conference opponents. Reclaiming early-season momentum remains the primary objective for the Baltimore organization moving forward.

The opposition presents a distinct challenge despite defensive vulnerabilities displayed throughout the autumn schedule. Buffalo has allowed opponents to surpass thirty points in five of their opening six matches. Capitalising on those defensive lapses will require precise execution from the returning quarterback and his supporting cast.

Addressing the offensive stagnation witnessed in recent quarters requires seamless integration of the veteran playmaker back into the primary game plan. Maintaining offensive possession and converting red-zone opportunities will dictate whether the squad can overcome recent disappointments. The coaching staff remains confident that the veteran's leadership will guide the team through this competitive stretch.

sections.heading: Implications for the division standings
paragraphs: The AFC North has emerged as one of the most fiercely contested groupings in professional football this season. Early successes enjoyed by the Baltimore franchise evaporated quickly during the recent two-game losing streak. Securing a win on Sunday is vital for preventing further separation from the division leaders.

Every conference matchup carries immense weight as teams approach the midpoint of the 2026 campaign. A successful outcome this weekend would alleviate mounting pressure on the coaching staff and restore confidence within the locker room. Conversely, another setback would deepen the current slump and complicate postseason aspirations.

The broader implications extend beyond the immediate fixture, influencing how opponents prepare for the Baltimore offensive scheme for the remainder of the autumn. Demonstrating that the star playmaker has fully recovered from his physical ailments will discourage opposing defenses from exploiting perceived vulnerabilities. The upcoming contest serves as a critical litmus test for the remainder of the schedule.

sections.heading: Outlook and upcoming schedule
paragraphs: Following this weekend's encounter against the Bills, the club faces a demanding series of fixtures designed to test their divisional standing. Managing player health and minimising further injuries will remain a priority for the coaching staff as the season progresses. The return of key personnel offers a timely boost during a demanding phase of the calendar.

Fans and analysts alike will closely monitor the mobility and effectiveness of the star quarterback during his initial performance back on the field. Addressing lingering discomfort will be balanced against the competitive urgency of securing a necessary victory. The team's immediate trajectory depends heavily on how smoothly the offense readjusts to its regular leader.

Ultimately, Sunday's performance will set the tone for the autumn months as the organization strives to regain its early-season form. Achieving a positive result on the road against a struggling defensive unit represents a tangible opportunity for redemption. The focus now shifts entirely to execution when the opening whistle sounds.
